description: This file defines the Surveys class for the SuiteCRM application, representing the survey module with properties, constructor, and methods related to survey data handling, including saving questions and options.

classes.name: Surveys
classes.description: Represents the Surveys module with properties for survey attributes and methods for saving questions and options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Surveys object by calling parent constructor.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the object implements a specific interface, here returning true for 'ACL'.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the survey object and associated questions and options from the request data.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Saves options for a survey question, creating new or updating existing options, and handling deletions.

methods.name: getMatrixOptions
methods.description: Returns an array of matrix options texts, default or customized.

methods.name: getSubmitText
methods.description: Returns the submit button text, defaulting to 'Submit'.
